historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly requires operator supervision and per-cycle checks, but does not distinguish OS warm reboot from kexec, BMC host reset, cold reset or power cycling, nor define timing and SY.1 artifact equivalence.

original_test_intent: Verify that every GPU consistently re-enumerates and retrains to its maximum supported PCIe generation at x16 with no correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 approved warm reboots, or through explicitly equivalent SY.1 evidence.
original_method: Pin one warm-reboot primitive and exclude cold reset, S5, AC/DC cycle and kexec unless explicitly approved; map GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to root ports/switches and maximum links; set graceful shutdown, reboot, firmware/OS/driver readiness and iteration timeouts; preserve baseline; supervise and number 25 reboots; after each boot collect complete GPU inventory, negotiated links, AER, driver and platform state; stop at the first failed reboot, missing GPU, downtrained link or new error and retain evidence.
manual_activity: An authorized operator drains workloads, initiates and observes each approved warm reboot, confirms console/OS/driver readiness, and owns failed-boot recovery.
required_inputs: Approved NVIDIA PCIe/GPU qualification and evidence toolchain
GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to root-port/switch topology with maximum generation and x16 expectation
Exact warm-reboot command and reset semantics, shutdown/reboot/firmware/OS/driver readiness deadlines and 25-cycle accounting
SY.1 artifact mapping, maintenance approval, zero-error scope, first-fault abort and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated drained SUT with console/BMC recovery and approved reboot access
Verify the command causes the intended warm reboot and does not invoke kexec, S5 or power cycling
Preserve logs and counters across iterations; do not clear evidence
Stop on shutdown/reboot timeout, boot loop, missing GPU, driver failure, link downgrade, new correctable/uncorrectable error, abnormal health or lost recovery access
No automatic retry or unsupervised loop
agent_execution_scope: Verify reboot primitive, topology, maximum-link matrix, timing/readiness, SY.1 traceability and recovery
Automate reboot accounting and evidence capture with approved operator oversight
Compare every GPU/link/driver state with the explicit oracle after each of 25 boots
Do not substitute other reset types, clear logs, infer missed cycles, continue after failure, retry automatically or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the exact warm reboot primitive and readiness deadlines, 25-cycle plan and SY.1 equivalence
Approve topology, maximum-link and zero-error acceptance plus stop/recovery rules
Review all iteration records and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed inventory and link checks fit post-boot verification, but the source lacks the authoritative reboot primitive, readiness gates, topology-specific link oracle and SY.1 evidence contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute exactly 25 approved warm reboots under operator supervision and collect the complete GPU/link/AER/driver/platform set after readiness and before starting the next iteration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Twenty-five warm reboots, SY.1 subset relationship, maximum supported generation x16, zero correctable/uncorrectable errors, no bundle, and 5/720-minute allocation remain; reboot mechanics and timing are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH 25-CYCLE WARM REBOOT GPU PCIE RECOVERY QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a numbered reboot ledger binding the exact reset primitive and each OS/driver-ready transition to a complete stable GPU/link/error snapshot before the next reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reset-type identity, readiness deadlines, stable topology oracle, complete per-cycle artifacts, first-fault retention and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final state or generic SY.1 PASS can hide boot loops, intermittent GPU absence, driver bind failures, transient downtraining or corrected errors during earlier cycles.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated warm reboot disrupts service and stresses firmware, PCIe enumeration and driver recovery; an automated loop without console interlock can trap the SUT in an unrecoverable boot cycle.

project_override_considerations: SY.1 can satisfy the row only if it used the same approved warm-reboot primitive and preserves all 25 complete per-cycle GPU/link/error records. AC/DC/S5 cycles, device reset and kexec are not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, tool versions, warm-reboot primitive and SY.1 traceability
GPU topology and maximum-generation x16 baseline with clean initial AER/driver/platform state
Twenty-five numbered command, shutdown, reboot, boot, OS and driver readiness timestamps
For every cycle: GPU inventory, lspci LnkSta/capabilities/AER, nvidia-smi, driver state, dmesg/journal, BMC/SEL and health
First-fault/recovery evidence or verified stable post-cycle-25 state
Engineer PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, Criteria and reviews consistently require 25 warm reboot recoveries. The precise reboot primitive and SY.1 artifact equivalence are pending execution definitions, not conflicting source objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The warm-reboot GPU PCIe recovery objective is clear. Reset semantics, tools, topology and evidence can be supplied, so the static review is not irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2147 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00024-V002: approve the exact warm-reboot primitive and exclude or explicitly permit kexec/cold reset/S5, define graceful shutdown and firmware/OS/driver readiness deadlines, 25-cycle accounting, GPU UUID/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix, SY.1 equivalence, zero-error scope, first-fault aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Separates warm reboot from other reset classes and makes each of 25 enumeration, driver and maximum-link recoveries independently auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Warm reboot preserves external power while firmware and the OS reinitialize devices, so it exercises a recovery path distinct from AC, DC/S5 and device reset. The exact primitive matters because kexec may bypass firmware and a BMC reset request may use platform-specific semantics. Since a later reboot can erase transient enumeration or driver evidence, each iteration must reach a defined ready state and be captured before the next reset; first failure stops the sequence.
